hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Following his presidential runoff loss to Lula, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro fled Brazil for the United States with the help of a former Mossad operative, igniting a major diplomatic and legal crisis. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and President Donald Trump face mounting scrutiny over granting him entry, while Brazilian authorities and legal groups move to suspend Bolsonaro's Senate salary and investigate his flight.
hotspots.affect: Commands extreme investment due to escape-drama narratives, accusations of judicial persecution, and high-stakes diplomatic confrontation between Washington and Brasília.

hotspots.title: Polish Constitutional Court Crisis & Coup Accusations
hotspots.blurb: Poland's constitutional conflict escalated into physical altercations after President Karol Nawrocki interrupted an official trip to Senegal to force entry into the Constitutional Tribunal. Law and Justice (PiS) leaders have denounced the Tusk government's suspension of top judges as an illegal coup d'état, while police forces and protesters surround court buildings in Warsaw.
hotspots.affect: Driven by apocalyptic legal-crisis framing, midnight presidential interventions, and allegations of an unconstitutional state coup.

hotspots.title: SD Internal Feud Over Swedish Identity Principles
hotspots.blurb: Sweden Democrats leader Jimmie Åkesson has threatened to expel internal dissidents who promote biological or strictly non-assimilable definitions of Swedish identity. The ideological battle between party leadership and ethno-nationalist hardliners has exposed deep internal factionalism and led to impending funding cuts for party-aligned media outlet Riks.
hotspots.affect: High emotional intensity fueled by internal betrayal narratives, purge warnings, and existential debates over core ideological principles.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen's 2027 presidential campaign momentum and RN congress were disrupted by severe security threats, including the arrest of an armed suspect planning an attack in Orléans, and a massive cyberattack leaking data of 150,000 members. Simultaneously, center-right figures like Bruno Retailleau launched sharp attacks claiming Le Pen's economic platform would financially ruin France.
hotspots.affect: Commands strong affective focus through terrorism/security threat alerts, major data breach anxiety, and fierce presidential campaign attacks.

hotspots.title: Nigel Farage MP Altercation Row & Reform Campaign
hotspots.blurb: Nigel Farage and Reform UK remain embroiled in continuous national contention following a parliamentary altercation and revelations that a campaign security guard was convicted of rape. Meanwhile, Farage continues to clash sharply with Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch over racial insults from allies and with Prime Minister Andy Burnham over historical slavery reparations.
hotspots.affect: Generates persistent heat through culture-war provocations, personal political rivalries, and tabloid scandal coverage.
